title: Dietary rotenone and paraquat on larval development
author: Wen Aw
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.rs8d6hw
materials: Rotenone (Sigma R8875) and paraquat were solubilised in DMSO to prepare a 5 mM stock.
Stock solutions were added to the diet to final treatment concentrations of 0, 3.125, 6.25, 12.5 and 25uM at 50°C

steps.title: Prepare chemical diet
steps.instruction: Add rotenone and paraquat to the larval diet so that each chemical is at an assay concentration of 3.13 µ (same unit as reported). Mix thoroughly to achieve a homogeneous diet.

steps.title: Conduct larval development assay
steps.instruction: Place larvae onto the prepared diet and allow them to develop under the standard rearing conditions used in the study.

steps.title: Assay Complex I activity
steps.instruction: For larvae that received rotenone, perform a Complex I activity assay following the separate “larval development and Complex I activity protocol” referenced in the text.
